pathParams.description: The name of the pool. It must be unique.

params.name: verbose
params.description: If enabled, will display additional data(eg. statistics).

application_list.description: Names of applications currently associated with the pool.

autoscale_status.description: Raw pg_autoscaler status object for this pool; shape varies between Ceph releases.
autoscale_status.title: Autoscale Status

crush_rule.description: The rule to use for mapping object placement in the cluster.
crush_rule.title: Crush Rule Name

fast_read.description: Set if the pool uses fast-read for erasure-coded reads.
fast_read.title: Fast Read

hashpspool.description: Set if the pool hashes pool id into its CRUSH placement-seed.

id.description: Numeric pool id assigned by Ceph.

min_size.description: Minimum number of replicas per object
min_size.title: Min Size

name.description: The name of the pool. It must be unique.

nodeep-scrub.description: Set if deep-scrubbing is disabled for this pool.
nodeep-scrub.title: nodeep-scrub

nodelete.description: Set if pool delete is blocked.
nodelete.title: nodelete

nopgchange.description: Set if changing the placement-group count is blocked.
nopgchange.title: nopgchange

noscrub.description: Set if scrubbing is disabled for this pool.
noscrub.title: noscrub

nosizechange.description: Set if changing the replication size is blocked.
nosizechange.title: nosizechange

pg_autoscale_mode.description: The automatic PG scaling mode of the pool.
pg_autoscale_mode.title: PG Autoscale Mode

statistics.description: Optional pool usage and IO statistics (only present when verbose=1 is requested).
statistics.title: Statistics

target_size.description: The estimated target size of the pool for the PG autoscaler.

target_size_ratio.description: The estimated target ratio of the pool for the PG autoscaler.

use_gmt_hitset.description: Set if hitsets use GMT timestamps (for cache-tier pools).
